# Evaluation report (measured, not estimated)
Produced by `python eval/run_eval.py --large`: uploads every file through the real REST API, waits for the background workers, and scores results against `eval/dataset/labels.json` (generated by `eval/make_dataset.py`, seed 7).
Environment: 4 workers, Tesseract OCR, rule-based extraction (no LLM key available during measurement), hash embeddings.

**Read this first - limits of the evidence:** the dataset is synthetic (3 invoice layouts, generated by me), and the extractor was tuned on failures this dataset revealed. Treat the numbers as an in-distribution regression benchmark, not a prediction of real-world accuracy. The LLM extractor was not measured.

## Dataset
88 files / 147 labeled records: digital PDFs (single, multi-page, 20-invoice batch), scanned PDFs and PNG/JPG at clean/noisy/poor quality, multi-page TIFF, XLSX (flat, long-format, form-layout, multi-sheet), XLS, CSV (semicolon), injected total/line-math errors, duplicates, missing fields, and 5 corrupt/encrypted/blank files.

## Headline metrics
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Document success rate (valid files) | 100.0% |
| Failure rate (valid files) | 0.0% |
| Corrupt/unreadable files correctly rejected | 5/5 |
| Record count correct per file | 98.8% |
| Overall field accuracy | 93.54% |
| Full-record exact match (all 8 fields + line items) | 88.44% |
| Line-item F1 (mean) | 0.921 |
| Fabricated values where truth is absent | 0/16 |
| Records with any error | 17 |
| ...of which routed to manual review | 88.24% |
| Silent errors (wrong but not flagged) | 2 |
| Non-injected docs flagged for review | 31.34% (mostly poor scans + layouts that never print a currency) |

## Large-file stress test (digital PDF)
941 pages, 400 invoices -> 400 records in 3.2 s (289.7 pages/s), invoice numbers recovered 100.0%. Digital pages only; a 1000-page *scanned* PDF would be OCR-bound (roughly 3-18 s/page at the measured per-page rates above, divided across workers).

## Known weaknesses
- Poor-quality scans (55% downscale, blur, noise, JPEG q35): ~17% accuracy; they are mostly caught by validation/confidence and sent to review.
- 2 silent errors: OCR typos in supplier names ("Industriat") that arithmetic cannot catch. Mitigation: supplier master-data fuzzy matching (not built).
- Layouts beyond the three synthetic ones are untested for the rule extractor; that is what the LLM path is for.
